sources.snippet: The most notable models in the series currently include: MiniCPM-V 4.6: 🔥🔥🔥 The latest and most efficient model in the MiniCPM-V series. With a total of 1.3B parameters, it surpasses larger models like Gemma4-E2B-it in performance, while showing superior efficiency than smaller models like Qwen3.5-0.8B (achieving ~1.5x token throughput).

It inherits the strong single-image, multi-image and video understanding performance of MiniCPM-V 2.6 with largely improved efficiency. sources.title: MiniCPM-V-4: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview MiniCPM-V-4 is a multimodal large language model with 4.1B parameters built on SigLIP2-400M and MiniCPM4-3B designed for single-image, multi-image, and video understanding. Created by openbmb, the model runs on standard transformers library with PyTorch and achieves an OpenCompass score of 69.0 across eight vision-language benchmarks, matching or exceeding GPT-4.1-mini-20250414 ...
